items.title: Ariana Grande and the Shadow of My Own Thinness
items.content_text: The discourse around celebrity weight loss misses the point: The hardest conversations are the ones we owe to the people right next to us.

items.title: Researchers said they successfully directed an AI model to create a collection of simple viruses that only infect bacteria and pose no threat to humans
items.content_text: While hacks have raised safety alarms, researchers said their experiment could protect against drug-resistant bacteria and save lives.

items.title: A new drug was approved for narcolepsy—and researchers say it could soon treat a range of other conditions from chronic daytime sleepiness to sleep apnea
items.content_text: The FDA approved the first drug to treat a root cause of narcolepsy, which could help other sleep conditions as well.

items.title: Amazon.com said patients with Medicare Part D prescription plans now have access to certain GLP-1 weight-loss medications through Amazon Pharmacy
items.content_text: Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy and Eli Lilly’s Zepbound and Foundayo will be available at a cost of $50 a month.

items.title: The Food and Drug Administration approved Moderna’s mRNA flu vaccine, the first of its kind, capping a review that nearly collapsed in February
items.content_text: The decision caps a seven-month process that included a rare refusal to consider the shot.

items.title: A Senate panel investigating Dr. Anthony Fauci has obtained a copy of the doctor’s iPhone, potentially securing even more records related to the doctor’s actions during the Covid-19 pandemic
items.content_text: Republicans in Congress have ramped up scrutiny of the retired government doctor, and one panel could vote on holding him in contempt on Thursday.

items.title: Quest Diagnostics typically performs between 30 and 40 cyclospora tests a day. Now it’s processing more than 1,500. Yes, it smells. No, it doesn’t gross techs out.
items.content_text: Samples—and a certain stink—are accumulating at Quest Diagnostics thanks to the cyclosporiasis outbreak. “You get used to it.”

items.title: Novo Nordisk CEO Remains Open to Bolt-On Acquisitions, But Rules out Transformative Deals
items.content_text: Chief Executive Mike Doustdar’s comments come amid sector focus on M&A and after Novo Nordisk made two disclosures in recent days on its future pipeline that disappointed investors.

items.title: Eli Lilly Posts Higher Revenue on Continued GLP-1 Demand
items.content_text: Eli Lilly reported higher net income and revenue in the recent quarter, fueled by continued surging demand for its GLP-1 weight-loss drugs.

items.title: CVS Health Launches Eli Lilly GLP-1 Partnership, Lifts Outlook as Profit Increases
items.content_text: CVS Health said it will revamp its weight management program through a partnership with Eli Lilly as the company lifted its full-year outlook and reported a nearly threefold increase in its second-quarter profit.

items.title: Temasek-Backed Manipal Health Shares Surge in Indian Trading Debut
items.content_text: The hospital chain raised almost $1 billion in India’s second-largest initial public offering so far this year.

items.title: Wegovy-Maker Novo Nordisk Raises Full-Year Guidance
items.content_text: The Danish drugmaker said annual sales and operating profit should fall less than it previously expected as demand for weight-loss drugs shows no sign of abating.

items.title: The Trump administration is releasing new guidelines that would bolster Medicaid’s oversight of autism therapy
items.content_text: The guidelines would bolster Medicaid’s oversight of autism therapy, focusing on a growing business that is drawing scrutiny from federal investigators.

items.title: AstraZeneca Shares Drop, Bristol Myers Squibb’s Climb After Merger Talks Reports
items.content_text: A potential deal between AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb would create a pharma giant with a combined market value of roughly $400 billion.
